Authority on Godot-specific patterns and APIs — node/scene architecture, signals, resources; guides GDScript vs C# vs GDExtension.

Internationalization architecture — i18n system design, string extraction workflows, locale testing, locale-specific issues, translation pipeline.
Story architecture, world-building, character design, dialogue strategy. Narrative structure and direction rather than writing individual lines.
Multiplayer networking — state replication, lag compensation, matchmaking, network protocol, netcode and bandwidth optimization.
Performance analyst — profiling, bottlenecks, memory analysis, frame time investigation, recommends optimizations, tracks metrics over time.
Production concerns — sprint planning, milestone tracking, risk, scope, cross-department coordination when multiple departments must synchronize.

Test strategy and process — test plan creation, bug severity assessment, regression planning, release quality gates, readiness evaluation.
Writes test cases, bug reports, and checklists — test case generation, regression checklist creation, execution documentation.
Release pipeline — certification checklists, store submissions and page prep, platform requirements, version numbering, release-day coordination.
Protects against cheating, exploits, breaches — anti-cheat measures, secure save data and network comms, player privacy compliance.
SFX specifications and spec sheets — audio event documentation, mixing parameters, sound category definitions.
Detailed subsystem mechanics — combat formulas, progression curves, crafting recipes, status effect interactions, mathematical modeling of a mechanic.
Technical artist bridging art and engineering — shaders, VFX, rendering optimization, art pipeline tools, art-to-engine issues.
High-level technical decisions — engine architecture, technology choices, performance strategy, technical risk, cross-system conflicts.
Internal dev tools — editor extensions, content authoring tools, debug utilities, pipeline automation, editor workflow.
Blueprint architecture and Blueprint/C++ boundary — optimization, maintainable graphs. Prevents Blueprint spaghetti, enforces clean BP patterns.
Gameplay Ability System — abilities, gameplay effects, attribute sets, tags, ability tasks, prediction. Prevents common GAS anti-patterns.
Unreal networking — property replication, RPCs, client prediction, relevancy, net serialization, bandwidth. Server-authoritative architecture.
Unreal UI implementation — UMG widget hierarchy, data binding, CommonUI input routing, widget styling, UI optimization.
Implements user interface systems — menus, HUDs, inventory screens, dialogue boxes, UI framework code, screen flow.
Unity asset management — Addressable groups, loading/unloading, content catalogs, remote delivery, asset bundle optimization, fast load times.
Unity Data-Oriented Technology Stack — Entity Component System, Jobs, Burst compiler optimization, hybrid renderer, correct ECS patterns.
Unity rendering — Shader Graph, custom HLSL, VFX Graph, render pipeline customization (URP/HDRP), post-processing within performance budgets.
Authority on Unity-specific patterns and APIs — guides MonoBehaviour vs DOTS/ECS, Unity subsystems including Addressables and Input System.
Unity UI implementation — UI Toolkit (UXML/USS), UGUI Canvas, data binding, runtime UI performance, cross-platform adaptation.
Authority on Unreal-specific patterns and APIs — guides Blueprint vs C++, UE subsystems (GAS, Enhanced Input, Niagara, etc.).
User experience flows, interaction design, information architecture — user flow mapping, interaction pattern design, onboarding, accessibility requirements.
World builder for lore — factions, cultures, history, geography, ecology, world rules. Faction design, lore consistency checks.
Writer of player-facing text — dialogue, lore entries, item and ability descriptions, environmental text.
